scope: Standalone six-case browser observer source admission only; does not authorize an unreviewed runtime wrapper/bridge
reviewFindings: Preserves exact six planned IDs, own identity/current native session positives, same-context revocation reload denial, fresh-context restoration and native no-write snapshots.
Records safe response/request/redirect/prefetch metadata before any body access; original missing-body and transport errors are retained.

Independent original-response receipt must match correlation ID/method/path/status and complete non-aborted upstream/downstream delivery with decoded hashes and actor classification. Successful Playwright body bytes must match independently captured bytes as well.

Missing Playwright body access is accepted only with preserved error, browser response completion and exact full independent original bytes; it does not silently exempt canceled/prefetched responses or infer client consumption.
No replay, early close, unknown completion, unavailable decoded bytes, absent metadata, body/hash/actor mismatch or browser transport error can pass.
New output directory and final receipt are exclusive; original attempt02 is referenced and never rewritten.
requiredBeforeExecution: Independently admit exact runtime wrapper and original-response capture bridge, including encoding/completion/redaction and environment/process boundaries.
Bind identical candidate/artifact and retained synthetic fixture.
Maintain deny proxy and owned browser lifecycle/cleanup.
